scope: Synthetic one-dimensional affine-source mechanism comparison. The historical 102.4 mm connector-arm OLS slope and residual RMS are scalar references only; particle positions and residuals are regenerated as paired uniform-position, Gaussian-residual numerical sources. The shared intercept is the existing synthetic-source baseline. For each declared source slope k, the same source is propagated through a zero-slope-derived design and a matching-k-derived three-zone/reflectron design. With the declared first-field, source-to-grid1, grid2-ratio and reflectron-stage1 controls frozen, the first-through-third focus equations derive the remaining two accelerator fields/lengths and reflectron second-stage field from k; they are not independently optimized. No claim about the historical finite source population, 3D transmission, source production, global optimization, collision or space charge.
